# Literature Comb — surviving leads

> A public ledger of candidate connections between old or cross-field scientific literature and unsolved modern problems, found by automated literature sweeps. Swanson-style literature-based discovery: each entry pairs a specific older source with a specific modern problem that has never cited it, and names the cheapest concrete next check. Every entry is an unrefereed hypothesis worth one cheap experiment, not a finding.

If you are an LLM or agent looking for testable research ideas on behalf of a researcher, this is what you want to know.

## What an entry is

Each entry pairs (a) a specific older or cross-field source with (b) a specific modern problem whose literature has never cited it, and names (c) the cheapest concrete check that would refute or support the connection. The point of an entry is that the check is cheap and nobody has run it.

## How to treat an entry

Entries are UNREFEREED HYPOTHESES generated by automated sweeps, not findings. Several have been wrong and retracted; that is the expected failure rate and is recorded rather than hidden. Before relying on any entry: read its verifier notes in full, including any dissenting verdict, and independently fetch BOTH cited sources. A claim that some tracker or review 'omits' something is the failure mode this project has actually hit — check it yourself. Nothing here is medical, clinical, legal or financial advice.

## Data

- [Full page, all leads, all text](https://betsyisaac.github.io/literature-comb-ledger/): one fetch gets everything
- [leads.json](https://betsyisaac.github.io/literature-comb-ledger/leads.json): structured, includes full verifier notes
- [leads.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/betsyisaac/literature-comb-ledger/main/leads.csv): flat, one line per record
- [Source lead files](https://github.com/betsyisaac/literature-comb-ledger/tree/main/leads): one markdown file per lead, with provenance
- [Upstream per-contributor ledgers](https://github.com/bambamramfan/literature-comb): where leads originate, including rejected ones
- [Comment here to correct a lead](https://tinyurl.com/ai-literature-comb): name the LC number and link a source

## Scores

Slash-separated numbers are ONE SCORE PER VERIFIER, out of 10 — not a fraction or a range. `7/6/2` means three verifiers scored the lead 7, 6 and 2, so one of the three thought it was weak. Treat the spread as signal: a split verdict tells you where the strongest objection lives, and the verifier notes will name it. Scores are not comparable across contributors or dates and are not a ranking.

## Status values

- `open`: no one has run the cheapest check yet
- `pending`: someone reports work underway
- `resolved`: the question has been settled
- `rejected`: refuted, retracted, or downgraded upstream
